plain.li: [fealty,warm] We have long hoped you would ask. One of ours will come to your gate for the oath, and your people will not regret it.
[fealty,warm,theirLowtech] It is a good thing, a small people under a strong roof. We will come to your gate to hear your oath.
[fealty,warm,theirHightech] Approved, and gladly. Expect our representative at your gate to formalize it.
[fealty,cordial] We accept. We will come to your gate for the oath, and then we will speak of what each side owes.
[fealty,cordial,call] Yes, we'll take it. Someone will be at your gate soon to hear the oath.
[fealty,cordial,theirLowtech] Your oath will be heard before witnesses, as is right. Make ready for us.
[fealty,cool] Very well. You will pay your share each season and send your fighters when we call, and we will see you are not overrun.
[fealty,cool,theirHightech] Terms accepted. Tribute on schedule, personnel on request, protection as available.
[fealty,cool,theirLowtech] We will take your oath. Do not make us regret the trouble of protecting you.
[fealty,refusal] We have enough to protect as it is. Look to your own walls.
[fealty,refusal,theirLowtech] We will not take an oath from people we barely know.
[fealty,refusal,theirHightech] Declined. Your settlement would cost more to defend than it would return.
[fealty,refusal,call] No. We're stretched thin already, and I won't promise what we can't deliver.
[greetings,warm,fealty:oath] It is good to hear from those under our protection. Write whenever you have need of us.
[greetings,cordial,fealty:oath] Our head asks after your harvest and your walls, as for all who hold of us.
[greetings,cordial,fealty:oath,theirLowtech] Our collector says your gate is always open to him. That is how it should be.
[greetings,cordial,fealty:oath,theirHightech] Your account with us is in good order. We appreciate the correspondence.
[greetings,cool,fealty:oath,fealty:short] We have your letter. We would rather have the tribute you still owe us.
[greetings,curt,fealty:oath,tie:fealty:due] Your letter came. Your tribute did not.
[news,cordial,fealty:oath,fealty:protected] Our fighters came back from your land with stories. They say your people fought well beside them.
[news,cordial,fealty:oath,fealty:levies] Our people speak well of the fighters you sent us. That is the kind of oath we value.
[greetings,warm,fealty:oath,fealty:levies] Your levies stood with ours when we called them. We will not forget it.
[help,cool,fealty:oath] You hold of us, so we will help where we can. Do not make a habit of asking.
[greetings,cordial,vassal:town] Our people at the town under your protection write home that they are treated fairly.
[greetings,cool,vassal:town,vassal:heavy] Our kin at the town you protect write that your share of their harvest is heavy.
[news,cordial,vassal:town,vassal:levy] Our kin under your protection sent their fighters when you called. We hope you remember that.
[greetings,cool,vassal:town,theirLowtech] Our kin hold of you now, by their own choice. Treat them as we would.
[fealtyoath,us] Welcome to our gate, we have been expecting you.
[fealtyoath,us] The colony is ready to swear, if your terms are what we were told.
[fealtyoath,us,theirLowtech] I have come to give the colony's oath, before you and before witnesses.
[fealtyoath,us,theirHightech] Let's go over the terms once more and then make it official.
[fealtyoath,us,abrasive] Say your terms and I'll say the oath.
[fealtyterms,them] Tribute each season, your fighters when we call, and our band when raiders come.
[fealtyterms,them] You pay your share at the season's turn, and you stand with us when we ask.
[fealtyterms,them,theirLowtech] Swear to send your spears when my horn sounds, and my spears will come to yours.
[fealtyterms,them,theirLowtech] A share of your harvest each season, and your oath on my people's name.
[fealtyterms,them,theirHightech] Quarterly payments, personnel on request, and our response team when you need it.
[fealtyterms,them] Keep the tribute honest and we'll keep the raiders off your walls.
[fealtysworn,them] Then it is sworn, and you are ours to protect.
[fealtysworn,them] Sworn, and my people will hear of it tonight.
[fealtysworn,them,theirLowtech] Your oath is heard, and my people will hold you to it.
[fealtysworn,them,theirHightech] Done, it's on record now.
[fealtysworn,them,kind] Sworn, and I hope this serves us both well.
